name: cli-proxmox
description: Proxmox VE for coding agents: an MCP server whose tools are the proxmox CLI commands — scoped by an API token and a profile, read-only by default, on Proxmox's own API schema.

interface.shortDescription: See and run your Proxmox VE lab, scoped and audited
interface.longDescription: The proxmox CLI as MCP tools: list VMs with QEMU's own state (an I/O-error pause is not "running"), show a VM's config, storages and LVM-thin pool use with a threshold, tasks and the next free id. An API token with a custom role on a pool is the boundary; the profile fences VM ids and a pool and is read-only by default. Built on Proxmox's own API schema, no third-party client.
defaultPrompt: How full is the thin pool?
Is VM 101 really running or paused on an I/O error?
